lead_raw_text:
The structure of TaMoO5 crystallizes in triclinic symmetry with space group P1 (No. 1). Its unit cell contains seven atoms—two Ta, one Mo, and four O—distributed across seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Mo as octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ta adopts a seven-vertex coordination environment with four O and three Ta neighbors. The analysis also reveals corner- and edge-sharing between Mo-centered octahedra and Ta-centered 7-vertex polyhedra, with an additional edge-sharing link between adjacent Mo octahedra.
